description: This file defines a custom exception class 'ShelfNameExistsException' used in the shelf management component of the book project. It extends IllegalArgumentException and is thrown when a shelf name conflict occurs.

classes.name: ShelfNameExistsException
classes.description: A custom exception indicating that a shelf name is already in use, used for handling specific error cases related to shelf naming conflicts.

methods.name: ShelfNameExistsException
methods.description: Constructor that creates an exception with a message indicating the shelf name is already used.
